verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is a first-party visual automation builder. Members define sequences of automated actions triggered by events such as "when a new deal is created" (attio-docs-103, attio-docs-17, attio-docs-126). Workflows can run agent steps (Web, Scoring, Routing and Custom agents) that enrich, score and route records without manual intervention (attio-docs-67, attio-docs-37, attio-docs-82). Users can also ask Attio's AI to build a workflow from a goal description (attio-docs-25), and the SDK adds custom triggers and steps (attio-docs-51, attio-docs-77). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the native Workflows product beyond marketing pages and SDK extension docs (e.g., scheduled/recurring triggers, run history and monitoring, execution limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably in the background.
